newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee closes at 35.86 against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee closes at 35.86 against dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.860/8650 against the dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
The rupee opened the day at 35.87/88 against the dollar.
Most of the day's business was done at 35.86/87 levels, dealers said. They said the day's quotes reflected dollar sales for Friday spot value.
"Otherwise the effective rate is steady at 35.88/98," said a dealer. Premia fluctuated on the forward dollar market.
The six-month annualised premium closed the day at 7.42 percent compared with the previous close of 7.47 percent.
